# web.dev

> web.dev is Google's comprehensive platform for learning modern web development, covering core technologies, performance optimization, accessibility, and emerging web standards.

Created by Google's Chrome Developer Relations team, web.dev provides free courses, guides, and best practices for building fast, accessible, and secure web experiences. It serves as an authoritative resource for web developers at all skill levels, from beginners to experts.

## Key Topics

- Core Web Vitals
- HTML
- CSS
- JavaScript
- Performance Optimization
- Accessibility
- Web Standards
- Chrome DevTools
- Interaction to Next Paint (INP)
- WebAssembly
- Web Platform APIs
- Semantic HTML
- Inclusive Design
- Progressive Web Apps
- Web Authentication

## Learning Paths & Courses

- [Learn web development](https://web.dev/learn): Learning hub with structured courses on HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and web technologies.
- [Learn HTML](https://web.dev/learn/html): Comprehensive HTML course from novice to expert level.
- [Learn CSS](https://web.dev/learn/css): Evergreen CSS course covering fundamentals through advanced styling.
- [Learn JavaScript](https://web.dev/learn/javascript): In-depth JavaScript course covering basics and programming fundamentals.
- [Learn Performance](https://web.dev/learn/performance): Performance course covering critical rendering path and optimization techniques.
- [Learn Accessibility](https://web.dev/learn/accessibility): Accessibility course with ARIA, keyboard navigation, and WCAG standards.
- [Learn AI](https://web.dev/learn/ai): AI course for web developers covering generative and predictive AI integration.

## Core Technologies & Guides

- [HTML](https://web.dev/html): HTML guide covering fundamentals, accessibility, and semantic markup.
- [CSS](https://web.dev/css): CSS guide with patterns, performance tips, and design best practices.
- [JavaScript](https://web.dev/javascript): JavaScript guide covering performance, INP optimization, and patterns.
- [Web performance](https://web.dev/performance): Web performance guide with Core Web Vitals and optimization techniques.
- [Accessibility](https://web.dev/accessibility): Accessibility guide covering WCAG standards and inclusive design practices.

## Specialized Topics

- [Explore](https://web.dev/explore): Learning paths covering Core Web Vitals, PWAs, and emerging web technologies.
- [Artificial Intelligence](https://web.dev/explore/ai): AI guide for web developers covering LLMs and client-side AI integration.
- [Identity](https://web.dev/identity): Identity and authentication guide featuring WebAuthn and passkeys.
- [Patterns](https://web.dev/patterns): Collection of code snippets and design patterns for web optimization.

## Community & Resources

- [Shows](https://web.dev/shows): Video series and shows covering web development news and updates.
- [About](https://web.dev/about): About page describing web.dev platform and Chrome Developer Relations team.
